## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `coupon` | `string` | **yes** | Parent coupon whose rules the codes inherit |
| `name` | `string` | **yes** | The coupon set's name. |
| `count` | `integer` | **yes** | How many unique codes to generate (1–10000) |
| `code_prefix` | `string` | no | Optional uppercase prefix, e.g. LAUNCH → LAUNCH-AB23CD45EF |
| `id` | `string` | no | Caller-named slug id; omitted = derived from name |
| `metadata` | `object` | no | Key-value pairs you attach to the coupon set. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The coupon set's id (`launch-codes`). |
| `name` | `string` | The coupon set's name. |
| `coupon` | `string` | The id of the coupon the codes in this set redeem (a slug id, e.g. `welcome-10`). |
| `total_count` | `integer` | Number of codes in the set. |
| `redeemed_count` | `integer` | Number of codes already redeemed. |
| `archived_count` | `integer` | Codes withdrawn via archive — spent, but not by a customer. |
| `unredeemed_count` | `integer` | Still redeemable. Not total_count − redeemed_count: archived codes are neither. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the coupon set was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `archived_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the set was archived (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `metadata` | `object` | Key-value pairs you attach to the coupon set. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `400` | Invalid coupon set |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/coupon_sets" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "coupon": "welcome-10",
    "name": "Welcome 10% off",
    "count": 1
  }'
```
